issue: G1 Smart Connect probe's server choice is dead code: SaveSettings() on line 537 immediately overwrites _settings.App.ActiveSubscriptionServer with SelectedSubscriptionServer?.Name (MainWindowViewModel.cs:3783), so the VPN connects to the stale VM selection (possibly a dead server) instead of the live server the probe just picked
fix: Before calling SaveSettings(), sync the VM selection to the probe's choice: var chosenVm = SubscriptionServers.FirstOrDefault(s => string.Equals(s.Name, chosen.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal)); if (chosenVm != null) SelectedSubscriptionServer = chosenVm; — then SaveSettings() persists the live pick and ToggleConnectionAsync connects to it
